Arun vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 84
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5337 of 2023
Applicant :- Arun

Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Tiwari,Alka Upadhyay Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Mrs. Alka Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned AGA for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
528 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC and 4/10 U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair means) Act 1998, Police Station-New Agra, District-Agra during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair means) Act 1998
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: According to the FIR, co-accused Kuldeep Sharma was apprehended in the examination room as an imposter when he was appearing in the examination in place of one Vikash Kumar Rathi and he disclosed the name of applicant.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant never promised to co-accused Kuldeep Sharma to give him Rs. 2 Lakh as mentioned in the FIR.
He further submits that complicity of applicant was disclosed through the disclosure statement of co-accused Kuldeep Sharma.

He further submits that co-accused Banti has already been released on bail by co-ordinate bench of this Court on 14.2.2023 vide Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 5100 of 2023 and applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail since 19.12.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant was one of the associates of co-accused Kuldeep Sharma, who was arrested at spot while he was appearing in the examination in place of Vikash Kumar Rathi.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of record, it appears that co-accused Kuldeep Sharma was appearing in the examination in place of Vikash Kumar Rathi and when he was arrested then he disclosed the name of applicant and two others and stated that they have promised him to pay Rs. 2 Lakhs.

Admittedly, applicant was not arrested at spot and except the statement of co-accused Kuldeep Sharma there is no other evidence against him on record and co-accused Banti has already been released on bail by co-ordinate bench of this Court on 14.2.2023 vide Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 5100 of 2023 and his bail order was produced by learned counsel for the applicant which is taken on record.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 5100 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: he is having no criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 19.12.2022, in view of this Court, it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Arun be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 / KK Patel  Arun vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24068428/
